name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.226.0 — A keep-forever criterion that points at an existing test with → reuses now counts as covered in the review matrix and the drift check, and protects that test from the expiry sweep, whatever id the test carries; one shared reader resolves the pointer. The test scanner reads table cases (it.each, test.for) and modifier chains (only, skip, concurrent, sequential, fails, todo, fixme) as cases, so the sweep counts and reports them and never deletes a file that still holds one. A File Plan row naming a bare root-level file (Dockerfile) is a path when its row carries a file action. Doctor's ledger check reads known stages from the fleet reader instead of a second list. 7.225.0 — /spec:mocks became the wireframe command over the walkthrough service: three states (SEED, SCREENS, APPROVED), gray json-render screen files, and rounds, notes and confirmations through the plugin's own client; a project without the walkthrough block confirms stories in the terminal. The old reviewer package, its contract file, the mock-app templates and the spec-paths mock-contract key are removed; genesis reads its counts from the seed and the latest round. 7.224.0 — The prototype freeze captures at the window size it writes into contract.json: states.json's viewport is resolved once, passed to every capture, and refused when malformed; a capture that recorded another size fails the freeze. The build capture gate replays each baseline's own recorded size (a contract naming a size its baselines never used no longer needs a re-freeze) and notes the disagreement. proto-capture --diff refuses two captures taken at different sizes instead of reporting every element as changed. The build's capture step names what the session must restore: prototype.url, a development build, the frozen states' data, and the sign-in file.
